settings.description: The first refinement pass optimized the encoder-input grid (100 px) while a tier-0 decoder renders 32 px, and it optimized squared error while the format is judged on dE00. refine_grid=1 moves the objective onto the decoder's own render grid, scored against the ideal full-basis downsample of the source. refine_obj picks what error means there: 0 = gamma sRGB, 2 = clipped OKLAB, 3 = clipped OKLAB with L/chroma weights.
